archive.title: Polo Grounds
archive.caption: The Polo Grounds was the name of four stadiums in Upper Manhattan, New York City, used mainly for professional baseball and American football from 1880 to 1963.

archive.title: Shea Stadium
archive.caption: William A. Shea Municipal Stadium, typically shortened to Shea Stadium, was a multi-purpose stadium in Flushing Meadows–Corona Park in Queens, New York City.
